Arjun K: Heads up — Q1 product drop looks like short microbursts. p95 RPS spikes ~3x for ~15-25m windows across regions. Need a prewarm/hedge plan (GPU hours + routing) before Friday.
Sophie L: +1. Region hedging + prefix KV warm cache seems best. Prewarm a small dedicated pool in us-east-1 and eu-west-1, then route steady traffic there. Save cross-region failover for saturated zones.
Maya Ops: We currently have ~1,200 reserved GPU hours in us-east for the weekend. We can reassign ~400h to a burst pool, but that eats into committed discounts. Quick cost note: 
```
Current reserved: 1200h @ $0.75/h = $900
If shift 400h to burst (on-demand pricing): 400h @ $1.25/h = $500 (delta +$200)
Avoiding 3x latency tail incidents likely saves > $2000 in downstream support/latency SLO penalties.
```
Ethan: Quick capacity calc — if microbursts are 20m each, 3x RPS for 2h total across the day, and one GPU handles ~80 concurrent low-latency generations:
```
Assume baseline pool: 40 GPUs
Burst peak needed: ~120 GPUs for 20m windows
Extra GPUs required: 80 GPUs * (20/60)h * number_of_bursts
If bursts ~6 across the day -> GPU-hours = 80 * (20/60) * 6 = 160 GPU-hours
```
So 400h of burst pool looks safe with buffer.
Arjun K: Also note embeddings egress can saturate inter-region links. Suggest capping frontend parallelism to 80% during peaks and route embedding-heavy requests to a quantized model variant in eu-west-1 as fallback. Update routing policy to `route_policy: peak-hedge-v1` with fallback to `redwood-emb-quant-1`.
infra-bot: Autoscaler: target for pool 'prod-prewarm' changed from 3 -> 6 nodes by Maya Ops at 1919992280.
Sophie L: I'll run a 2-hour synthetic run: 25x clients hitting /v1/generate, seq_len=512, mix=70% chat/30% embeddings. Scheduling Thursday 03:00 UTC. Can anyone confirm window? :calendar:
Maya Ops: 👍 confirm. I'll block capacity and shift 400h to burst pool now.
Ethan: One more operational detail — prewarming GPUs alone won't populate KV cache. We should seed with a replay of high-frequency prefixes. Use `tools/cache-seed --dataset launch_prompts_2026 --target-pool prod-prewarm`. Also set `--seed-rate 500/s` for ~30m to saturate cache.
Arjun K: Action items: 1) Maya — shift 400 GPU hours into burst pool and update cost tracker, 2) Sophie — run synthetic Thursday 03:00 UTC, post results, 3) Ethan — prepare cache-seed script and dry-run it today, 4) I'll push `route_policy: peak-hedge-v1` with quantized fallback and monitor error budgets. Ping here when each is done. :rocket:
